newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kolon Ind issues bonds with warrants.
newsitem.headline: Kolon Ind issues bonds with warrants.

text.p: South Korea's Kolon Industries Inc said it privately placed 30 billion won worth of bonds with warrants on Wednesday to raise operating funds.
Ilshin Investment Corp is the underwriter of the issue, Kolon said in a statement.
The bonds carry a coupon of 10 percent and will mature on March 26, 2000.
The bonds can be exchanged to Kolon's common shares one month after the issuing date until March 25, 2000.
Conversion price was set at 14,700 won per share. The company's shares closed at 13,900 won on Wednesday.
If fully converted, the company's share capital will increase by 2.04 million shares to 15.50 million.
